name: qualstack
description: QualStack — a Claude Code plugin for qualitative and mixed-method political science, built on Integrated Inferences (Humphreys & Jacobs 2023). Sibling to MStack; inspired by gstack.

plugins.name: qualstack
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin for qualitative and mixed-method political science — 46 role-based slash commands across the life of a case-based study (ideate, model, design, collect, analyze, write, submit, reflect), built on the causal-model approach of Integrated Inferences and the CausalQueries R package; a methods reference library (process tracing, case and clue selection, mixing methods, sources and interviews, transparency and human-subjects ethics); hook-enforced evidence integrity and a wall around identifiable material.
